label: Test a fixed existence-fact edge at the strict PLG supply bridge
summary: The illumination paradigm supports a direction from the emitter's activity, at emission time, to the particular illumination at reception time, in the selected respect. It does not establish that illumination at reception time t depends on the emitter's existence at t: at a positive distance, light in transit can arrive after the emitter ceases operating. Concurrent existential supply is the first open test. It also leaves open whether the emitter's existence fact is itself a partial explanation of the illumination's existence fact. On the separate Boolean control from PR #2087, the same coextensive facts and fixed labels have an initial strict step and no finite weak return in strictForward. The weak-only comparison lacks any strict path between those labels. Keeping the strict sequent while identifying coextensive labels would give a strict self-sequent. The worked Lean application composes the path theorem and the finite-ancestry theorem on the converse of the stipulated nature relation, with finite Boolean labels. The ontic cause relation is empty. This witnesses the formal composition and supplies no actual efficient-causal edge or independent evidence for the stipulated orientation.
blocker: No independently warranted existence-fact orientation was identified for an actual distinct edge. The emitter's operation at emission time and transmission explain the illumination at reception time; no case yet shows concurrent existential supply at one time t. Even for a case passing that test, the contribution of the emitter's existence fact as partial ground is open. General coverage in a single theory, alignment of the selected per se relation, and finite upstream labels per effect remain separate.

current_assessment.scope: One candidate sustaining edge and the worked coextensive control for the existing path–map–accessibility route.
current_assessment.assessment: The fixed-label test excludes an extensional identification that retains the strict edge in the consistent Boolean presentation. The causal direction in the illumination paradigm has local warrant, while an account through activity and transmission explains the same effect without committing to a strict PLG edge on the proposed existence facts. Withhold the existence-fact export on that case. The direct-assumption options and the earlier four-premise accessibility argument retain their scopes.
current_assessment.next_test: Fix one actual supplier and recipient with evidence of concurrent existential supply in one respect. Identify what the supplier's existence fact contributes as a partial explanation of the recipient's existence fact, and check the initial sequents and all weak returns in a presentation whose steps have that warrant. Only then test coverage over the independently selected per se links and the effect-local bound on upstream labels.
current_assessment.evidence: Baseline PRs #2040 and #2087, the worked Lean application StrictGroundSupplyEdge.lean, and the existing registered path and finite-label results.
current_assessment.supersedes: None. This refines the next test on one edge and retains the earlier warrant and formal assessments.
